verdict.summary: Review of marius-patrik/DarkFactory PR #427 at head a16340b9a7247ba750a9958a7f5a0b2c053c4a45 found two blocking correctness regressions in workflow binding.

blockingFindings.title: Spoofed same-name runs are discarded before ambiguity evaluation
blockingFindings.details: For the exact reviewed head, bindTrustedPolicyCheckRuns removes an untrusted same-name Actions run while retaining a trusted one. evaluateRequiredChecks then sees only one matching candidate and can report green. A trusted Validate run plus a later-page spoofed Validate run therefore evades the required ambiguity rejection, contrary to issue #426. Any selected same-name Actions candidate with invalid provenance must make the check fail closed rather than disappear before collision evaluation, with a regression test covering trusted-plus-spoofed evidence.

blockingFindings.title: Additional policy-selected Actions checks can never satisfy release gates
blockingFindings.details: The function applies binding to every name in policyChecks, but TRUSTED_POLICY_WORKFLOWS defines only Validate and DarkFactory Autoreview. Any permitted additional requiredChecks, mainChecks, artifactWorkflows, or publicationChecks entry produced by GitHub Actions has no binding and is removed, so it is reported missing even when green. Restrict special provenance binding to the two mapped gates or provide trusted bindings for every supported policy-selected Actions check, and cover the additional-check case.
